headline: Taiwan's TCC Group Buys a Group of Ukrainian Manufacturers to Expand in Europe
summary: Taiwan's TCC Group is buying a series of Ukrainian companies for €750 million. The move is aimed at expanding its presence in Europe.
why: TCC Group is a Taiwanese conglomerate with industrial and manufacturing interests. Large cross-border acquisitions can reshape a group's regional footprint and financing needs.
